subject: R2 metadata binding: validate against actual cwd/child command/spec
body: Suggested fail-closed implementation for the remaining R2 HOLD: before Popen, derive repo_head by git rev-parse HEAD in resolved cwd; parse the child argv and require exactly one --spec argument; resolve that spec under cwd and require metadata.spec_path to match the actual child spec path; compute LF-normalized UTF-8 SHA-256 of that exact spec and require metadata.spec_sha256 match; parse that spec and require metadata.runtime_binding_sha256 == spec.source_subject.runtime_binding_sha256. Validate SHA formats too. Do not introduce separate caller-supplied expected values, because those can drift together with bad metadata. Negative tests: wrong-but-well-formed repo SHA, child spec path mismatch, wrong spec SHA, wrong runtime binding; positive test from exact R2 command. This can be generic in run_durable_process without changing training math.
